meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude会把任务拆成多个可独立执行的阶段，先派出子代理查阅文档、确认真实API，再据此写出带验证清单和反模式提醒的实施计划。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划某个功能、任务或多步骤实施时触发，尤其在用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我规划实现用户登录功能，先查文档再分阶段。
say.note: Claude会先派子代理查文档，再给出分阶段计划。

say.text: 我要重构旧模块，请先做文档发现再制定实施计划。
say.note: 会先找现有API和示例，避免用不存在的接口。

say.text: 用 do 执行前，先给我一个带验证清单的多步计划。
say.note: 计划会包含验证步骤和反模式提醒。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator: it first dispatches subagents to read documentation and confirm real APIs, then writes a phased implementation plan with verification checklists and anti-pattern guards for each phase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before running it with do.

say_en.text: Plan a login feature for me: check docs first, then break it into phases.
say_en.note: Claude will send subagents to read docs, then give a phased plan.

say_en.text: I want to refactor the old module—do documentation discovery before planning.
say_en.note: It will find existing APIs and examples, avoiding invented ones.

say_en.text: Before running with do, give me a multi-step plan with verification checks.
say_en.note: The plan will include verification steps and anti-pattern reminders.
